professionalSummary: Associate Product Manager at Calder Building Society (Feb 2022–Oct 2024) with experience leading discovery, defining requirements, coordinating compliance and fraud controls, piloting payment features, managing roadmaps, and reporting to senior stakeholders.
experienceHighlights: Conducted 18 discovery interviews with members managing shared expenses and authored prioritized requirements for in‑app payment requests.
Agreed payment‑request limits and confirmation‑of‑payee checks with compliance and fraud teams, documenting controls in the feature risk assessment reviewed by second‑line risk before pilot.
Led a six‑week colleague pilot of payment requests in an internal beta build with 150 staff accounts, collecting feedback via in‑app survey.
Maintained the payments squad backlog in priority order and co‑authored the quarterly roadmap with the engineering lead, re‑ranking items after each sprint review.
Presented monthly payments updates to the digital steering group, covering backlog progress, pilot feedback, and open risks, with a one‑page summary sent the day before launch.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Close‑out deck for the colleague pilot, including survey results, defect counts, and open‑risk list; slide titled ‘Launch’ states ‘Launched 9 November – payment requests live in the app’ with a screenshot from the beta build.
